name: emerald
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and inline diagnostics for the Emerald language

emerald.checkCommand.markdownDescription:
Command run to check a file. `{file}` is replaced with the file's path. Must print the JSON that `emerald check --json` produces.

The default routes through WSL, because Windows Smart App Control blocks the compiled interpreter. If you run Emerald natively, use `emerald check --json "{file}"`.

Set to an empty string to turn inline diagnostics off.
